sentences.text:
Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja
Manoj Kumar Vs. State of H.P. Cr.

Present: Mr. Devender K.
Sharma, Advocate, for the .
petitioner.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent-State.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, learned Additional Advocate General, accepts service of notice on behalf of the of respondent-State.
He prays for and is granted two week's time to file status report.

In the interim, it is ordered that petitioner shall be released on bail, in the event of his arrest in case FIR No. 146/2023, dated 27.08.2023, under Sections 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 6 and 21 of POCSO Act and Section 67 of Information Technology Act, registered at Police Station Bhoranj, District Hamirpur, H.P., on his furnishing personal bond to the tune of Rs.
25,000/- (Rupees twenty five thousand), with one surety in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
1. That the petitioner will join investigation of case as and when called for by the Investigating Officer, in accordance with law.
2. That he will not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them/him/her from disclosing such facts to the Investigating Officer or Court.
3. That he will not tamper with the prosecution evidence nor he will try to win over the prosecution witnesses in any manner.
4. That he will not leave India without prior permission of the Court.

. 
...2...
This order shall remain in force till 6th November, 2023, on which date, status report/reply shall be filed by the respondent-State.
